verdict.rationale: E2B offers a separate Desktop SDK providing mouse, keyboard, screenshot, application, and desktop streaming APIs, confirming full desktop environment support, but this is a distinct add-on SDK rather than a built-in capability of the core Sandbox, and there's no dedicated documentation excerpt (only a GitHub README mention) or independent hands-on confirmation of headless browser use. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the Desktop SDK setup/usage, explicit headless browser example, and independent/community verification of desktop streaming in practice.
